description: This file defines the AWS HealthClient class which interacts with AWS Health APIs. It specifies method signatures for various API calls related to AWS Health notifications and organization-specific data, inheriting from AwsClient.

classes.name: HealthClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Health APIs, providing methods to describe affected accounts, entities, events, and health status related to AWS organizations.

methods.name: describeAffectedAccountsForOrganization
methods.description: Retrieves affected accounts for an AWS organization.

methods.name: describeAffectedEntities
methods.description: Retrieves affected entities based on provided criteria.

methods.name: describeAffectedEntitiesForOrganization
methods.description: Retrieves affected entities within an AWS organization.

methods.name: describeEntityAggregates
methods.description: Provides aggregated data on AWS health entities.

methods.name: describeEntityAggregatesForOrganization
methods.description: Provides aggregated data on entities within an AWS organization.

methods.name: describeEventDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about specific events.

methods.name: describeEventDetailsForOrganization
methods.description: Retrieves detailed event information for an AWS organization.

methods.name: describeEvents
methods.description: Provides information about specific health events.

methods.name: describeEventsForOrganization
methods.description: Retrieves events related to an AWS organization.

methods.name: describeHealthServiceStatusForOrganization
methods.description: Gets the status of AWS health services within an organization.

methods.name: disableHealthServiceAccessForOrganization
methods.description: Disables access to AWS health service data for an organization.

methods.name: enableHealthServiceAccessForOrganization
methods.description: Enables access to AWS health service data for an organization.
